newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Cosmos Jan-Feb net seen at 70 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Cosmos Jan-Feb net seen at 70 mln pesos.

text.p: Cosmos Bottling Corp said on Monday it expected its net income in the first two months of the year to hit 70 million pesos compared with 20 million in the same period last year.

"We are on track in hitting our projected profit despite the higher depreciation expense. In fact, we expect our cash profit this year to reach a level of 700 million pesos," Cosmos president Jose Concepcion said in a statement.
The soft drinks maker said its high cash-to-credit ratio of 90 to 10 would ensure its healthy balance sheet. "Virtually we sell almost everything in cash," it said.
Last year, Cosmos funded its one billion peso expansion through cash the company generated.
Cosmos said it remained confident that consumers would continue to choose its products despite price reductions by competitors. It said it will maintain prices of its soft drinks at current levels.
Cosmos has not increased its prices in the past three years.
The firm said it has cornered a 17 percent market share in the Philippine soft drinks market.
Cosmos is a unit of Philippine food and beverage conglomerate RFM Corp.
